{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter to only completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Display conversion rates
conversion_rates"}
